items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.contentSnippet:
🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
https://jingyaogong.github.io/minimind

 
 

 
 
 
 
     
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
"大道至简"
 
 
 
 
中文 | English
 
 
 
 
此开源项目旨在完全从 0 开始，仅用 3 块钱成本与 2 小时训练时间，即可训练出规模约为 64M 的超小语言模型 MiniMind。
 
 
MiniMind 系列极其轻量，主线最小版本体积约为 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$，力求让普通个人 GPU 也能快速完成训练与复现。
 
 
项目同时开源了大模型的极简结构与完整训练链路，覆盖 MoE、数据清洗、预训练（Pretrain）、监督微调（SFT）、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自适应思考与模型蒸馏等全过程代码。
 
 
MiniMind 同时拓展了视觉模态模型 M

items.contentSnippet:
Here is a fun project if you want to make an open-source Meta Muse Charm.

I mapped the screen, audio and power-latch pins with no schematic, and wired a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 to press its physical buttons automatically behind a packet-loss router to test bad Wi-Fi.

items.title: Show HN: bouncemarket – a live prediction market game for a bouncing ball
items.contentSnippet:
a ball will fall. trade on where it lands.
I made this game! Some technical details:
The entire drop of the ball is simulated server-side, then streamed to each client as server-sent events with a small buffer. Every drop is deterministic from its starting position, so rounds can be replayed exactly for later analysis, but tiny variations in starting position can change the ultimate outcome.

items.title: Show HN: Woodada – Cats that run across your taskbar as your CPU gets busy
items.contentSnippet:
Woodada is a free desktop app for windows and mac. Two cats, one for CPU and one for memory, run along your taskbar or Dock. The busier your computer gets, the faster they run.
I loved RunCat but wanted the cat actually running across my screen, where I'd notice it. The cat sprites come from RunCat365 (Apache 2.0).
I built it with C#, .NET 9 and Avalonia, with help from AI. Just run the .exe or open the .dmg. As the cats run they collect fish, which you can spend on new colors and skins.
